description: Russian candidate dissertation prose. Flags unbounded novelty, a topic presented as a defence proposition, and improvement claims that require frozen comparative results.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:не имеет аналогов|аналогов не существует|единственн\w+ в мире)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: Remove the absolute novelty claim or cite a separately established comparison corpus and boundary.
Name the comparison corpus or prior capability that bounds the novelty claim.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:на защиту выносится|положением,? выносимым на защиту,? является) (?:метод|методика|модель|алгоритм|система|устройство)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: State a falsifiable assertion supported by a result, not only the topic or artifact name.
Link the improvement to a frozen comparative result with value, conditions, and unit.
